entries.evidence: Sixth EWRAM overlay, found in live play during the plaza cutscene near the psynergy stone (2026-08-08). The session froze; reproduced headlessly from savestate 5 plus the recorded input, where it aborts with 'SELF-HEAL bridge for 0x02008BBC exceeded 200000000 instructions without returning to stop_pc=0x0808D88C'. Identified by dumping the live window via GBARECOMP_TRANSIENT_DUMP (0x02008000..0x0200C8BC) and matching it against the pinned decompressed overlay set: it is rom_784360 byte for byte, all 16084 bytes from offset 0. overlay.elf places a $t mapping symbol at 0x02008bbc and OvlFunc_bbc (STT_FUNC, thumb bit set) at exactly that address, so this is an exact THUMB function entry, not an interior resume point

Same overlay and same play session; reported by the runtime as 'unknown transient code identity at 0x02008158' with every registered overlay mismatching. overlay.elf: $t mapping symbol at 0x02008158 and OvlFunc_158 (STT_FUNC, thumb bit set) at exactly that address
